description: This file contains implementation of SOCKS5 client helper functions for configuring proxies, generating SOCKS messages, and managing SOCKS connection states within a WebSocket server framework.

methods.name: int lws_set_socks(struct lws_vhost * vhost,const char * socks)
methods.description: Parses and sets the SOCKS proxy address, port, and optional user credentials in the virtual host structure.

methods.name: int lws_socks5c_generate_msg(struct lws * wsi,enum socks_msg_type type,ssize_t * msg_len)
methods.description: Generates various SOCKS5 protocol messages based on the specified message type for negotiation, authentication, and connection requests.

methods.name: int lws_socks5c_ads_server(struct lws_vhost * vh,const struct lws_context_creation_info * info)
methods.description: Configures the SOCKS proxy server address and port, using explicit info or environment variables.

methods.name: int lws_socks5c_greet(struct lws * wsi,const char ** pcce)
methods.description: Initiates the SOCKS5 handshake by sending a greeting message to the proxy server.

methods.name: int lws_socks5c_handle_state(struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd,const char ** pcce)
methods.description: Handles the state machine for SOCKS5 connection negotiation, including reading responses and progressing through handshake steps.

ctags.name: lws_socks5c_handle_state
ctags.signature: (struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd,const char ** pcce)
